_om: Papegøyen in English (Polly, rusj.no/en/polly/) – the yes/no game: answer everything without saying «yes» or «no». Key = the Norwegian text in spill.js. The yes/no questions and follow-ups are in data.en/sporsmal.json, written for the UK (no negative trap questions). Shared words come from rusj/kit/tekst.en.json.
Topp fem av {n}. Hele lista kommer på sl: Top five of {n}. The full list comes at the end.
Én sitter i papegøyestolen og svarer på: One player sits in Polly’s chair and answers questions – without saying ‘yes’ or ‘no’. Polly hears everything!
De andre leser spørsmål fra mobilen elle: The others read questions from the phone or make up their own. The faster, the trickier.
Sier den i stolen «ja» eller «nei», tryk: If the one in the chair says ‘yes’ or ‘no’, tap ‘Said it!’. That’s the end of the turn.
Sekundene du holder ut, blir poengene di: The seconds you last are your points. Most seconds at the end wins.
Svar med «det stemmer», «absolutt» eller: Answer with ‘that’s right’, ‘absolutely’ or ‘not at all’ instead.
Følg opp med «Er du sikker?» og «Lover d: Follow up with ‘Are you sure?’ and ‘Promise?’ – that catches most people out.
Strenge regler: heller ikke «jo», «jepp»: Strict rules: no ‘yeah’, ‘yep’ or ‘nope’ either. With the nodding ban you can’t nod or shake your head either.
Trykket noen «Sa det!» ved en feil? «Ang: Someone tapped ‘Said it!’ by mistake? ‘Undo’ gives the time back.
You can always skip a turn.
Everyone gets a turn in Polly’s chair.
Dere kan også stille egne spørsmål under: You can ask your own questions along the way too.
Heller ikke lov å nikke eller riste på h: No nodding or shaking your head either.
Choose at least one pack to start.
De andre stiller spørsmålene – fra mobil: The others ask the questions – from the phone or their own.
Alle sa det med en gang. Det er jo det s: Everyone said it straight away. That’s what makes it so fun!
Holdt ut i {tid} til sammen uten å si «j: Lasted {tid} in total without saying ‘yes’ or ‘no’.
No problem! The turn goes on to the next player.
Den som har holdt ut lengst så langt, vi: Whoever has lasted longest so far wins.
